radiusSource: Radius 44.550 (41.278 to 47.530) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 30,993,407 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 4.897 (4.791 to 4.938) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4708 +/- 0.9 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 960732373927616768: teff_gspphot 4707.7114 K (16th-84th percentiles 4706.83-4708.632), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 960732373927616768: teff_gspphot 4707.7114 K (16th-84th percentiles 4706.83-4708.632), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
